story: Julius Johansen delivered a dominant performance to win Stage 5 (ITT) of the Volta a Portugal 2026. Enzo Leijnse was the first rider to break the 22-minute barrier, but Johansen soon set the benchmark time. No rival came close thereafter, securing him the stage victory, while Alexis Guerin retained the overall lead.
